claim_ceiling: This machine-readable matrix registers competing mechanism hypotheses and exact observation support. Published 2021 and 2026 treatment results are literature evidence. No child CSV files have been ingested or joined, and no mediation effect or causal mechanism has been estimated.

source_evidence.finding: P increased annual root productivity and diameter and decreased potential root phosphatase activity; cations increased root productivity in some periods, diameter and AM colonisation; P and cations increased corresponding tissue concentrations; no N responses reported.

Fine-root stock showed no significant treatment effect; P increased turnover by 23% and 48% in years 1 and 2; cations reduced year-two turnover by 24%; P×cation and N×cation interactions were reported.

support_and_causal_rules: The treatment assignment unit is plot; five points, root tips and repeated campaigns are nested observations, not randomized replicates.
AM colonisation is 0-10 cm only; it must not be used as a 0-30 cm mediator without a justified support mapping.
Morphology and phosphatase retain 0-10 and 10-30 cm strata.
Root nutrient concentration is a Nov 2017-Aug 2018 composite over four intervals; do not assign it a single February measurement date.
AM percent root length is not fungal transfer flux or carbon cost.
Potential ex-situ phosphatase activity is not in-situ phosphorus uptake flux.
The 2018 traits are post-treatment observations and may precede year-two turnover; treatment randomization does not randomize mediator levels.
A treatment effect on a mediator and a later mediator-outcome association do not establish causal mediation.
A 0-10 cm trait and a 0-30 cm turnover target are different estimands; request depth-resolved stock data before testing a depth-matched response.
The fine-root standing-stock data used in the 2026 turnover paper are available from the corresponding author on reasonable request; public EIDC productivity files alone do not reproduce turnover.
